title: Intersection of Multiple Arrays
description:
You are given a 2D array nums.

Each nums[i] is a list of distinct positive integers
Task

Find all integers that are present in every array.
If not then return [-1]
Return them:

In ascending order
Examples

Example 1

[[3,1,2,4,5],[1,2,3,4],[3,4,5,6]]
→ [3,4]

Example 2

[[1,2,3],[4,5,6]]
→ [-1]
Constraints
1 ≤ number of arrays ≤ 1000
Total elements ≤ 1000
1 ≤ value ≤ 1000
Each inner array has unique elements
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
